translation_notes: prepareQuery(text, initNs) + g.query(q) becomes s{ ... }(g): the initNs dict and the prepareQuery import (module-level context) are replaced by three @prefix declarations (rdf, base, onem2m), the prologue being the block's. The query keeps its DISTINCT, so it is not a basic graph pattern and m{ } would change the multiplicity: s{ } is the construction.
Rows keep working as in the original: iterating s{ }(g) yields rdflib ResultRow, so `" %s %s %s %s" % row` and row["device"] are unchanged.

Fixture: two complete devices (a 2x2x2 product for one), an incomplete device, a device of another class, a Device with the predicates in the wrong namespace and an untyped subject; the driver adds a decoys-only graph (zero solution), a single device, a prefilled list and an empty graph. Compared: returned list, mutation of the list, stdout. A mutant removing the rdf:type pattern fails (verified).
The @id of the result is the last device seen: the order of the store is not promised, the run is stable because both sides query the same graph with the same algebra.
